summary: The ko-nafəq plant example at 75/19 is duplicated under Preterit Intransitive and ko-Preterit; retain it in ko-Preterit.
rationale: Identical Turoyo and reference, with overt ko-, also occur as nfq.I.t.ko-preterit.1.

summary: Remove the unrelated 33/4 citation from the brothers’ hunting example
rationale: The quoted sentence about two brothers going hunting is exactly at the already-listed 78/5. 33/4 discusses the people of ʕIwardo leaving their village and their casualties; it shares the form nəfqiwa but not this quotation or narrative context. Retain 78/5.

summary: Remove 75/189 from the quotation about distinguishing true and false
rationale: The full quotation is at the already-listed 24/19. 75/189 has neither this wording nor a form of nfq: it concerns being unable to stop people and their causing an uproar. The automatic best match 75/353 is also unrelated. No replacement verse in text 75 is justified.

summary: Match the translation to the first-person plural forms
before: so arbeitete ich weiter in meinem Beruf als Chauffeur
after: so arbeiteten wir weiter in unserem Beruf als Chauffeure
rationale: šaġilina is first-person plural, and -ayḏan in šŭfērtiy-ayḏan means our. Both contradict ich/meinem in the translation. EL 26 itself is not supplied; the proposal follows the entry’s Turoyo.

summary: Move the b-ʕayn d-ruḥi sensation example from III.1 to III.2.
rationale: The printed gloss explicitly says nichts gemerkt / mir nicht wehe getan, matching III.2 fühlen/spüren/merken; it describes no extracted object.

summary: Move the existing 60/78 speech-deciphering example from III.1 to III.2.
rationale: The 60/76–77 context explicitly concerns finding out what pigeons say, using books and philosophy; existing III.2 includes discovering/discriminating abstract content.

summary: Assign the unnumbered ko-Preterit example to III.1.
rationale: ko-mawfaqqe a=nvinaṯṯe describes physical removal of beds; the missing sense tag is structural, not a new use.

summary: Move the example meaning not notice/feel to sense 2
rationale: Its translation ich habe nichts gemerkt, mir nicht wehe getan describes sensation or awareness, matching existing sense 2 etwas merken ... fühlen, spüren. Sense 1 describes bringing out. The same b-ruḥi construction is correctly under sense 2 in nfq.III.t.infectum.9.

summary: New box Nomen Actionis: example for sense 1 in Nomen Actionis (11/22)

rationale: First I.1 Nomen Actionis example; feminine nfəqte d yawmo means the eastern direction in a complete monastery-location statement.

summary: New sense 8: (mit b-; Zeitung) erscheinen, veröffentlicht werden
rationale: The account appears in a publication medium, rather than leaving a location or a name becoming famous; two passages from the same speaker.

summary: New sense 7: erzählen, kundtun, offenbaren (Geschichte, Geheimnis)
rationale: An information object is communicated outward: habitual recounting, divulging a secret and making a story public. III.2 is acquisition of knowledge; III.5's uncertain vermitteln is illustrated by giving sword-fighting instruction, not securely this use.

summary: New sense 8: freilegen (Fels durch Abtragen der Erde)
rationale: A fixed bedrock patient becomes exposed by excavation; it is not carried out. One attestation, MAC Ishaq Material culture/48.

summary: New sense 9: herstellen, hervorbringen (Form, Gerüst)
rationale: The builders continue assembling supports until a qaləb/šəkl comes into being. Two tokens in one passage and a less explicit precursor at /54; this differs from moving an existing object.

summary: New sense 5b: sich beim Zählen oder Wiegen als eine bestimmte Zahl oder Menge ergeben

data.label: 5b
data.gloss: sich beim Zählen oder Wiegen als eine bestimmte Zahl oder Menge ergeben

rationale: Counting and weighing explicitly license a numerical result, specializing I.5's qualitative 'sich herausstellen als'. Product emergence with a quantity NP remains I.1 where no measurement is predicated.

summary: New sense 9: herstellen, hervorbringen, nachbilden (Form, Gerüst, Muster)
rationale: The shape-creation construction established in batch 1 also covers reproducing a bracelet pattern: rasm is the object, and 57/197 explicitly reformulates it with sym 'make'. This widens the objects of III.9 without introducing another numbered sense.

data.translation: Auf diese Weise, (zeigt sich) das Glück, wie es heißt. Wenn die Glücks- (münze) dem Bräutigam oder der Braut zufällt, dann bedeutet das, dass der Betreffende von Gott geliebt wird und dass er eine chancenreiche Zukunft hat – der, in dessen Anteil sich die Münzen finden. These counts describe the compressed input background, not new example quotas and not independent counts to add again in later batches.

Aspect: qaṭəl nafiqo/nafiqi occurs with attained results and current exposed positions; it is not automatically Part act. nafoqo. Infectum-wa/Preterit-wa contrasts remain morphological even when the edition uses another tense.

Valency: I shows entity/product subjects with m- sources; III shows an agent and theme, sometimes a fronted theme resumed by -la/-nne. b- can mark an aperture, an instrument or an awareness argument; that preposition alone cannot determine the sense.

No Detransitive form is established by an edition's impersonal or passive translation. Contracted məfq-/mofaq- forms belong to III, while nfq/npq orthographic variants remain an editorial consolidation question.
Exact repetitions in a verse receive separate decisions but a single selected example. Existing EL 26 and JL 12.14.4 were recognized across citation/transcription aliases.

Batch 2 retains all batch-1 labels. New I.5b specializes predicated numerical results of counting/weighing. Quantified material outputs remain I.1, so the earlier grape-syrup yield decision is not overturned.

The pox collocation already accepted from JTM 5.2/11 is independently supported by 56/110. Egg comparisons recur at 64/95 and 66/8; heart-source retention/forgetting recurs with person, longing and story subjects.

PrS has repeated invariant masculine-looking nafəq before feminine snakes, other feminine NPs and quantified plurals. Record the pattern; do not repair agreement or infer a new paradigm solely from the edition translation.
Reduced məfqile/məfqila forms and external l-agent NPs contrast with intransitive nafəq-le beneficiary/target suffixes. An l-suffix on nfq I does not by itself establish the transitive Preterit.

Source translations are uneven: PrS 46/2 lacks the fruit-setting clause; it is not quoted. Several Ritter strings visibly contain OCR/edition corruption (61/241, 62/132, 64/58, 64/102); quoted strings are preserved exactly and flagged for editorial checking.
